paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Torsion-pendulum search for axion-wind coupling to electrons over masses 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV. The main result is a limit on Ce/Fa (axionlike decay constant scale), reported as Fa/Ce > 2 PeV = 2e15 eV over much of the range. The exclusion plot (Fig. 5) shows Ce/Fa vs ma but no numerical table is provided in the text; unaveraged limits are in Supplemental Material (not included). No extractable (mass, coupling) pairs given numerically. Coupling type is AxionElectron, but note the paper uses Ce/Fa convention rather than dimensionless g_ae; conversion would require g_ae ~ 2*m_e*Ce/Fa. The flat limit value Fa/Ce >= 2e15 eV corresponds to Ce/Fa <= 5e-16 eV^-1. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Y-axis is C_e/F_a in PeV^-1, not literally g_ae; the plotted constraint is on the axion-electron coupling/decay constant ratio.
